label: Golden and differential tests
subgoals: Compare every change against golden outputs
Run old and new versions side by side on the same stimulus
Use the last approved version as the reference

label: Choosing the equivalence method
subgoals: Check register correspondence before choosing the method
Use sequential equivalence when state encoding changed
Account for latency when pipeline stages were added

label: Intended changes and quality
subgoals: Bound where an intended change moves behavior
Check each distinct parameterization of a changed module
Report quality regressions beside the equivalence result
